prompt: Create an original 60 second bossa nova instrumental composition for quiet reading and reflective study. Mood: calm, intimate, warm. Instruments: nylon guitar, shaker, upright bass, electric piano. Style: syncopated guitar chords with gentle Latin groove. Tempo approximately 104 BPM; D major. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Keep the arrangement sparse and dynamics even; leave space for thought. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:20] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:20-00:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [00:40-01:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:00.

description.en: A smooth and relaxed jazz instrumental featuring a prominent piano melody, supported by a walking upright bass line and light, brush-driven drums. The track has a sophisticated and calm atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首流畅轻松的爵士乐器曲，以突出的钢琴旋律为主，配以行走的低音提琴和轻柔的鼓点。这首曲子营造出精致而平静的氛围。
